notes.title: Small Ballmart Patch...
notes.content: There always HAS to be something small wrong with it on the first try. At least I'm not alone and the whole industry is familiar with "day one patches".

notes.title: Ballmart Update!
notes.content: Added a shop, coins, 7 ball skins (for now, more on the way), and a level select!

notes.title: Updates updates!
notes.content: Added[b] local saves[/b], and a [b]New Game[/b] option! PP will now [b]save[/b] your progress! Also, some more small fun tweaks.

notes.title: Update!
notes.content: Added pause menu, and some extra instruction text!
